synopsis: In early 1913, a remarkable historical overlap saw Hitler, Stalin, Trotsky, and Freud residing simultaneously in Vienna.
narration: In early 1913, a shocking alignment occurred in Vienna. Adolf Hitler, Joseph Stalin, Leon Trotsky, and Sigmund Freud all lived in the same city. The future architects of global conflict and modern thought, unknowingly sharing the same streets. A profound historical coincidence.

Focus on the anonymous faces in the crowd, hinting at hidden historical figures moving within the urban flow. Rainy, reflective cobblestone street.

Intimate, slightly claustrophobic interior of a traditional Viennese coffeehouse in 1913. Ornate decor and dark wood, with a mix of patrons: some engrossed in newspapers, others in quiet conversation. A solitary, intense-looking young man with a mustache sketches in a notebook in the foreground, his face partially obscured, hinting at a hidden identity. Low, warm lighting.
